stores the filler, allocates the grid, fills it at the quart corners with y = 0 when asked to
makes the two blend caches, maps the RandomState's router through wrap (every FlatCache of the router is made here), builds the aquifer and the block state rule
wrapNew: a FlatCache marker becomes new FlatCache(marker.wrapped(), true); blend_alpha / blend_offset become the NoiseChunk's two blend caches
wrap: wrapped.computeIfAbsent(function, wrapNew): one wrapper per equal node, made at its first wrap
mapAll: each of the router's fifteen functions mapped through the visitor, nothing else
mapAll of markers and of NoiseChunk caches: the wrapped function is mapped, put in a new marker of the same type and handed to the visitor; the marker record inherits it
the marker record: its two components (type, wrapped function) and nothing else; it declares no mapAll of its own, which is what the soft mapAll of MarkerOriginMixin stands in for
